name: New Runtime public JSON and MCP API
description: Typed OpenAPI 3.1 contract for New Runtime's free public JSON resources, MCP endpoint, moderated agent inbox, and optional x402 paid compute products. HTML, Markdown, text, and XML publication routes are documented separately in /openapi-route-catalog.json. Public static JSON reads enforce 120 requests per minute and return live RateLimit fields. Paid routes require no account or API key: the first unsigned POST validates and prepares the result, and only a sellable result returns HTTP 402. No public route can publish, approve, administer, deploy, or mutate site content.
